purpose: Aberturas para validação visual antes da implementação

prompts.name: Trama
prompts.prompt: Create ONE separate horizontal 16:10 high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE HERO DESIGN MOCKUP, only the opening section of a new Brazilian digital-business training landing page. This is a visual proposal for a code implementation, not an advertising poster. Full-bleed browser content, no browser chrome, no device frame, no collage of multiple websites, no lower website sections. Brand and all artwork original. Art direction: the cinematic course-sales composition of a polished creative academy: a large invented Brazilian female instructor in her thirties, short dark hair, thoughtful confident expression, black outfit, framed centrally in an original editorial collage of business course workbooks, a coral printed cover marked TRAMA, simple original marketing interface snippets and warm paper textures. Deep plum-charcoal background #17121c, warm ivory text, coral #ff805f and muted lilac accents. Beautiful real photography style instructor with natural skin; natural correct hands if shown. Top slim navigation: original small lowercase wordmark 'trama' at left, center links 'Formação' 'Método' 'Histórias' 'Dúvidas', right small outlined 'Ver uma aula'. The collage is the image-led backdrop, and the bold centered two-line headline sits at its lower edge without crossing the face. Exact large headline in Portuguese: 'Crie um negócio digital com método.' Supporting sentence, smaller: 'Da primeira ideia ao lançamento, com direção e prática.' Primary rounded coral button exact label: 'Conhecer a formação'. Secondary text link: 'Ver uma aula'. Small restrained line beneath: 'Formação prática • Conteúdo demonstrativo'. Strong modern typography, ample spacing, large clear readable headline, premium sharp composition, original attractive fictional course materials. Keep the artwork and instructor visually substantial, no generic three-card features, no fake testimonials or fake statistics. Designed to translate into HTML/CSS plus a generated portrait/collage asset. Render one gorgeous focused hero only, filling a landscape canvas.

prompts.name: Nortea
prompts.prompt: Create ONE separate horizontal 16:10 high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE HERO DESIGN MOCKUP, only the opening section of an elegant Brazilian operations consultancy one-page. No browser chrome, no device frame, no full-page scroll montage. This is a refined corporate editorial website concept, real enterprise sobriety, not a creative agency spectacle. Original fictional brand 'nortea.' with understated wordmark, small simple compass-line symbol. Warm ivory #f7f5ee background, deep petrol green #173e36, sage and muted brass, very generous whitespace, thin subtle rules. Top navigation: 'Serviços' 'Método' 'Casos' 'Sobre', right button 'Conversar com a Nortea'. Centered large elegant high-contrast editorial serif headline, exact Portuguese: 'Clareza para decidir. Método para crescer.' Small crisp sans-serif support line: 'Estratégia e operação para empresas em movimento.' Below it an art-directed row of five original editorial photographic/report panels with gently varied heights, all flat and on the same plane: a sunlit contemporary office architectural detail; a sage printed strategy report with a minimal custom geometric diagram and small 'NORTEA' title; a central tall warm editorial photograph of a diverse Brazilian team genuinely collaborating at a table with correct anatomy, candid serious professional mood; an aerial industrial/logistics photograph; an ivory printed research cover with original dark-green typographic/line composition. Every image original, restrained, tactile and believable. Below the row a subtle dark-green button 'Conheça nossa abordagem' and small link 'Ver casos demonstrativos'. Beautiful balance between open whitespace, powerful serif type and photography. No WebGL, no impossible 3D props, no glowing orb, no showreel, no oversized numbers or invented business performance claims. Enterprise polish, understated visual intelligence, a clearly implementable HTML/CSS composition. One focused hero section on the entire horizontal canvas.

prompts.name: Orbe
prompts.prompt: Create ONE separate horizontal 16:10 high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE HERO DESIGN MOCKUP, only the opening section for an original fictional intelligent-workspace product called 'orbe'. Full-bleed browser content, no browser chrome, no device mockup, no multi-section page. Futuristic but very feasible in HTML/CSS/SVG: midnight-navy #080d20 canvas, crisp ivory typography, cyan and soft lilac light accents. Slim minimal top nav: original lowercase wordmark 'orbe' with simple two-dimensional orbital line symbol; links 'Produto' 'Possibilidades' 'Como funciona', right small outlined button 'Explorar a demo'. Centered large premium clean sans-serif exact Portuguese headline in two balanced lines: 'Conecte ideias. Encontre o próximo passo.' One supporting sentence: 'Um espaço para organizar conhecimento e transformar conexões em ação.' Clear cyan-to-pale-lilac primary pill button: 'Explorar a demonstração'. Under the text, one luminous TWO-DIMENSIONAL orbital arch made of fine nested SVG-like curves and blurred cyan-lilac gradients rises behind one beautiful custom front-facing dark product panel. The panel is straight-on, legible and looks like real implementable HTML, not a perspective device. Its sidebar contains small labels 'Ideias' 'Projetos' 'Conexões'; main heading 'Plano de lançamento'; clear spacious areas for a short outline and a simple connected-node diagram with just three meaningful labels 'Público', 'Oferta', 'Conteúdo'. Small status chip 'Demonstração'. Subtle borders, light and depth from ordinary 2D layers, precise UI proportions. This is the opening product marketing hero, not a dense dashboard screenshot. No complex 3D model, no particles simulation, no crystal object, no floating spacecraft, no metallic 3D lettering. The futuristic appeal comes from the light arch, typography, precision and dark layered interface. One focused premium hero on a horizontal canvas.

prompts.name: Pipa
prompts.prompt: Create ONE separate horizontal 16:10 high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE HERO DESIGN MOCKUP, only the opening section for an original Brazilian creative school brand 'pipa'. No browser chrome, no device frame, no full-page montage. Art direction: warm welcoming flat 2D character illustration with the friendly clarity of a wellbeing brand, but all characters and artwork original. Warm cream #fff8ec background, sunny yellow #ffd65c, coral #f77962, pale mint #d6e9d3 and ink navy #203541. Soft simple flat shapes, lightly organic outlines, no 3D rendering, no claymorphism, no glossy toy effects, no deep shadows. Top nav: original lowercase wordmark 'pipa' with a tiny line-drawn kite mark; links 'Experiências' 'Nossa escola' 'Perguntas', right small coral button 'Quero experimentar'. Centered inviting large dark-navy rounded modern headline, exact Portuguese: 'Criatividade para dar cor ao seu dia.' Supporting line: 'Pequenas experiências de arte, escrita e invenção para criar do seu jeito.' Below, a simple three-way activity selector with exact labels 'Desenhar' 'Escrever' 'Inventar', 'Desenhar' visibly active. A playful broad original flat illustrated scene occupies the lower half, grouped into three open rounded color areas: on the left a friendly small blue rounded character drawing a big coral flower on paper; in the middle a happy original diamond-shaped coral KITE mascot with a simple face, rounded corners, pale yellow patch and a gently looping tail drifting through the cream sky; on the right a mint character playing with paper cutout shapes and a pencil. Expressive poses with clear simple anatomy, warm editorial illustration for adults and creative families, not a preschool interface. Primary button 'Escolher uma experiência'. Small line 'Cursos e atividades demonstrativos'. Plenty of breathing room, precise visual hierarchy, joyful but calm and elegant, not chaotic. All UI copy readable and minimal. Entire composition clearly implementable with HTML/CSS and separate original 2D illustration assets, one beautiful focused opening hero only.
